title: parathelypteris flaccida
intro: Parathelypteris flaccida, commonly known as the lacy male fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is a medicinal plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Parathelypteris flaccida include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and acting as an antiseptic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
